notes.title: [Sales Stall Rework] Dustland Delivery Update v1.20.1021
notes.notes:
Hello, Dustlanders!

In this update, we've reworked the sales stall system, alongside a number of other improvements. See below for details:


New Stall System
Now, when you're in a city, you can select \[Set Up Stall] from the interactions menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c72658d4643bd7adc6789e363f6f531fd56277a9.png"]

In the old system, you would randomly sell food, parts, or equipment taken from your inventory. Now, after choosing the type of product you want to sell, you will enter a new "Stall" screen as shown below.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/893ea268cc2c42961e802f0a4c7d91596b0fa82a.png"]

✅ Product types currently available for sale:

Cooked food

Equipment/truck parts

📈 How to Sell Products:

When you set up your stall, you must select one member of your crew to be your Salesperson. Choose a character from the panel in the bottom left.

You will attract a certain number of customers with each shift depending on city size, your Salesperson's Speech stat, time of day, and other factors.

Choosing \[Next Shift] will advance time and increase your Salesperson's Stress and Fatigue.

Characters with Stress or Fatigue over 90% cannot be your Salesperson.

If no crew members are able to be your Salesperson, your stall will automatically close.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/d0131d23103cc136afc1faad60638a75f306de19.png"]

After setting up your stall, select \[Next Shift] to attract customers who want to purchase your goods.

Each customer will have specific needs, and will grant you corresponding rewards for fulfilling them.

The more of a customer's needs a product fulfills, the more they will pay.

You can check the Customer Queue to see your customers' needs and formulate your sales strategy.

You must fulfill at least one of a customer's needs in order to make a sale.

Mouse over a product to see how many of the current customer's needs it can fulfill, then click the product to try to sell it to them.


Other Improvements[olist]
Added a Continue button to the main menu.

Added an Urgent Engine Repair feature. Now you can repair your truck's engine even if you are not in a city.
[/olist]


Thanks again for all your support!

notes.title: Dustland Delivery v1.20.645 Update (Fishing System Redesign)
notes.notes:
Hello Dustlanders!
With the newest update, we have redesigned the existing fishing system.

Entering the Fishing System
When your truck is located near a river, you can choose either [Fish] or [Quick Catch].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/3ceba87ee944f469ffaddd6908d2c803239f5481.png
Choosing [Quick Catch] will advance time, add to your Crew's Fatigue, and grant you fish depending on your Crew Fishing stat.
Choosing [Fish] will enter the new fishing system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/66ef1c5836d9ef933da63fc18a028852c3c09640.png

Gameplay

Casting/Retrieving Your Line
Click [Cast Line] to start fishing. After a moment's wait, you may be able to hook a fish. You can also choose [Put Away Rod] to stop fishing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/bfe659b10cf61e75fed1abbbe070a1279bbedfea.png

Catching Fish
After a moment's wait, you may be able to hook a fish, shrimp, or other aquatic creature. You might also unwittingly dredge up a piece of trash.
Once you've hooked a fish, it will begin to struggle. This is expressed through the "Struggle" and "Strength" bars.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/168b2d499c9a2f2231d3533beedd23dd503e2845.png
Different fish have different Strength values, and the Struggle meter will fill up gradually over time. Once the Struggle meter reaches the maximum, the fish will try to escape your lure, depending on its current Strength.
Of course, the rivers of the Dustlands are home to many other strange things too.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f8e2df481de2e4adbda8c3a3e6ec4546d7aa5add.png
If you hook a piece of trash, it won't struggle. But as it will be heavier than a fish, it will move by a shorter distance when you try to reel it in.

Reeling in Your Catch
Clicking [Reel In] will have the following effects:
  a. Your lure will move toward your rod (i.e. to the left).
  b. Any items you hook will move toward your rod (but by a shorter distance than the lure).
Each time you click [Reel In], your lure will move toward you by a small distance, as will any item you may have hooked, depending on its attributes. If the distance between your lure and the item you hooked exceeds a certain value, the line will snap, and your catch will escape.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/0cbf738603de6727088de2474d90afb81409a0e4.png
If you have hooked a fish, its Strength meter will be reduced each time you reel it in. When its Strength reaches 0, it will stop struggling for a moment until its Strength recovers again. Each time a fish's Strength is exhausted, this will reduce the maximum limit of the Struggle meter. In other words, the more times you exhaust a fish's Strength, the weaker it becomes.

Stamina
A character's Stamina is determined by their Fitness stat. Fishing costs Stamina. Once a character has exhausted their Stamina, they can no longer continue fishing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/12c29a74811545bb1bf269b363ea2a420c792cad.png

Results and Rewards

Success
If you can successfully pull your lure to the left hand side of the progress bar without your line snapping, you will retrieve your catch.
If you hooked a live animal, you will receive it as a reward.
If you hooked trash, you will receive materials such as Pig Iron or Leather.

Failure
If the distance between your lure and the fish becomes too large and causes your line to snap, or the fish reaches the right hand side of the meter, you will fail. The character who is currently fishing will receive an increase to their Fishing stat.

Results
Whether you succeed or fail, all characters who take part in fishing reduce their Stress and increase their Fatigue according to how much Stamina they consume.
If a character takes part in fishing but does not consume any Stamina, then their Stress and Fatigue will stay the same.

We've also made the following changes:
1. Added the ability to drop all Inedible Food at once.
2. Fixed display errors in the main interface.

Thanks once again for your support!

notes.title: Dustland Delivery v1.20.583 Update (Redesigned Hunting System)
notes.notes:
Hello, Dustlanders! Please see below for notes on this week's update:

◈ Update Version
v1.20.583

◈ Update Details
1. Redesigned the hunting system.
With the newest update, we have redesigned the existing hunting system.
When you stop your truck in the forest, you can search for animal tracks, which have a chance to give you a hunting task.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/cb55c50a87dbb26e5ec5b9e2b2034d2b470f94b9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/aca41811ce3b3c3407807c81d3f2098ffb918730.png
When you reach the location indicated by the task, the hunt is on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c7491046cc430bdb9faef1fffde23def40338bad.png
When hunting, you must use a variety of actions to get closer to your prey without alerting them in order to increase your chances of success. Finally, when the time is right, you can capture your prey and complete the hunting task.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f8e770478c0862074395dc186d8c5cc97d5d336a.png
Distance will affect the success rate of hunting; the closer the distance, the higher the probability of a successful hunt.
When their alertness reaches the maximum limit, your prey will flee, and you will fail the hunting task.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/6cc57c348acfbadd03321665c4836fd8b0f0e164.png
Different actions have different chances of success and different effects on your prey's alertness and distance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/782becbd183e49a74c1c76e6ab41f5d77bc3d3e5.png
Chances of success are determined by your Crew Hunting, Fitness, and Focus attributes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/2926a07e5d544c6eab252d2617ff68776acad2bf.png
A successful hunt will bag you different prey depending on the area. A failed hunt will also increase your Crew Hunting attribute. Whether you succeed or fail, going hunting will reduce your crew's Stress.
Please note that while you spend time hunting, the Infection and Risk meters will gradually build. If you spend too long, your crew might end up coming under attack from infected.

Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where achievements would be displayed repeatedly in certain circumstances.
2. Fixed an issue where certain notification windows would be erroneously displayed in Chinese.
3. Fixed an issue where the Reinforced Axle would erroneously reduce Speed in certain circumstances.
4. Fixed a text display issue when buying or selling goods from caravans visiting player-owned cities.
5. Fixed issue where text would exceed text box limits in the combat screen.

Improvements
1. Improved trait point notification display timing.
2. Improved notifications when truck Hull is low.

One more thing: the Dustland Delivery Steam Workshop beta test has begun! See the official announcement for further details on how to take part.
We're hoping to make Steam Workshop support available as soon as possible. We're also planning to host a mod creation contest event, so stay tuned for further details!

Happy gaming!

notes.notes:
Hello, Dustlanders! 
Since the release of Dustland Delivery, we've been keeping a careful eye on player feedback and suggestions in our community pages, and working hard to implement suggested changes. We've just finished work on the latest update. See below for details:

◈ Update Version
v1.20.511

◈ Major Additions
1. Added new custom character portraits
2. Improved the crafting screen: you can now use materials stored in your city's Depot when crafting
3. Added one-click storage and withdrawal of goods in the Depot
4. Updated cloud save functionality

◈ Bug Fixes
1. Fixed display issues in the Bar screen
2. Fixed possible UI display issues when opening the Settings screen
3. Fixed display issues under certain circumstances in the character info screen
4. Fixed progression issues for certain side story tasks
5. Fixed an issue where the bank would lose players' deposit/loan information under certain circumstances
6. Fixed an issue with the effects of the truck part, Radiator
7. Fixed display issues with certain log texts
8. Fixed certain text display issues in Salary Mode

◈ UI Improvements
1. Improved display in city Depots: you can now toggle between different types of goods
2. Improved the Eat screen: more information now available
3. Improved purchase screen: now displays the change to your truck's load after a transaction
4. Improve game log screen

◈ Text Improvements
1. Changed text content for certain side stories
2. Changed text content of certain character traits

◈ Notes
If there are any changes to the details, we will update you through this notice.
Please update Dustland Delivery on Steam to the latest version for the changes to be applied.

Thank you for your feedback and suggestions, and for your continued support of Dustland Delivery!

notes.title: Release v1.20.485 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, Dustlanders! 

Dustland Delivery has been in Early Access for a week! Thank you to all our community members for your suggestions and feedback.
Even if we can't reply individually to each message, we pay close attention to community discussions, and we're working hard to bring you a better game experience. 

◈ Update Version
v1.20.485

◈ Update Details
1. Updated auto-crafting and crafting materials system
2. Fixed an issue where some notifications would not close properly
3. Fixed translations and icons for certain items
4. Fixed an issue where characters with the Child trait could become companions
5. Fixed name display issues for areas in the center of the map
6. Fixed an issue where removing the Celibate trait would have no effect
7. Fixed compatibility issue with custom characters and Salary Mode
8. Improved notification display logic
9. Improved sequence for certain story events
10. Fixed issues related to engine repair; you can now only repair your engine in cities with a Repair Shop (does not affect Hull repairs)

◈ Notes
If there are any changes to the details, we will update you through this notice.
Please update Dustland Delivery on Steam to the latest version for the changes to be applied.

Thanks once again for your support and your feedback!
